name: ai-discoverability-audit
title_zh: 在 ChatGPT 里搜不到你品牌？这份审计告诉你缺
tagline_zh: 别等客户用 AI 搜竞品才着急。输入品牌名，它模拟四大 AI 引擎的抓取视角，输出你被漏掉的关键词。
tagline_en: Stop losing customers to AI search. Enter your brand, it simulates how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude & Gemini see.
desc_en: Audit how a brand appears in AI-powered search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). Use when user mentions "AI search," "how do I show up in ChatGPT," "AI discoverability," "AEO," "LLM visibility," or wants to understand their brand's AI presence.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的 SEO 建议，而是逐引擎拆解它们的抓取偏好与引用逻辑。
why_en: No generic SEO fluff. It reverse-engineers each engine's crawling quirks, showing exactly why Gemini cites you but ChatGPT.
limit_zh: 只审计品牌在 AI 搜索中的文本可见度，不含视频/播客等非文本内容；需要你提供品牌官网和主要社媒链接；产出是诊断报告。
limit_en: Audits text-based AI visibility only (no video/podcast). Needs your site + social URLs. Outputs a diagnosis, not rewritten content.
title_en: Brand invisible in ChatGPT? Audit finds the gap
